newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends three cents down at 14.40 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends three cents down at 14.40 rgt.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia ended three cents lower at 14.40 ringgit ($5.74) a kg on poor buying demand abroad, traders said.

"The market was marginally lower. There was hardly any keen interest from abroad," a trader said. There were bids of 59 tonnes at the opening against offers of 113 tonnes. Final turnover was 108 tonnes against 204 tonnes on Friday, with buying mainly from Europe, Japan and locally.
The local price premium over LME was $25 a tonne against Friday's $15. --Tan Lee Lee (603-206-2323) ($1=2.5045 ringgit)
